test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Today, children consult each other and go with the flow.
Today's kids are involved in decision making.
Parents' advice often sounds like preaching to the children.
Kids are not given the freedom to choose what they want.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Kids are not given the freedom to choose what they want.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the 7th line, it is said **"We empower our kids to take their own decisions from a very early age. We ask them the cuisine they prefer, the movie they want to see, the holiday they wish to go on and the subjects they wish to study". **
 
• Hence, it is clear that the statement given in **option 4** is not true.
